# ClaravDecor
Event decor and balloon design studio in North Dallas, TX (service-area business based in 75248, no showroom). Founded 2019 by Clara Vento, 10 years of experience. English and Spanish.
Phone: (469) 567-0386 · Email: info@claravdecor.com · Hours: Mon–Sun 8:00 AM–8:00 PM · Instagram: @claravdecor
Canonical site: https://claravdecor.com

## How it works
Free quote in 24–48 business hours → we read your space (indoor/outdoor, surface, power, weather) → a deposit reserves your date → we design it and send you a mockup to approve → installed before your first guest arrives, takedown included.

## Pricing
Organic balloon garland from $250 (up to 8 ft, up to 3 colors, delivered and installed within 20 miles of 75248). Full event design is quoted around your venue and vision. Deposits are non-refundable; a distance fee applies outside the core area; short-notice bookings may include a small fee.

## Service area
Core (no travel fee): Dallas, Addison, Richardson, Carrollton, Farmers Branch, Coppell, Plano.
Extended (distance fee): Frisco, McKinney, Allen, Garland, Irving, The Colony.
